Replaceable pickup lip.purpose: Get under the leading rim of a floor NOTE and feed it up to the nose roller.
Replaceable pickup lip.rationale: A blunt polymer edge offers a replaceable wear surface. The roller remains exposed across its working width.

Pickup lip crossbar.purpose: Back the full blade width and transfer its load to the side extensions.
Pickup lip crossbar.rationale: The long span needs support behind the thin leading edge.

Cassette side beam extension \u00b7 left.purpose: Carry the pickup crossbar from the existing cassette side beam.
Cassette side beam extension \u00b7 left.rationale: A 30 mm side lap transfers load around the nose shaft. The end of the extension supports the crossbar.

Cassette side beam extension \u00b7 righ.purpose: Carry the pickup crossbar from the existing cassette side beam.
Cassette side beam extension \u00b7 righ.rationale: A 30 mm side lap transfers load around the nose shaft. The end of the extension supports the crossbar.
